description: Multi-Circuit Electric Consumption Thailand Home Dataset (MCEC-Thai) is a data set described in the paper "Multi-Circuit Electric Consumption Thailand Home Dataset (MCEC-Thai)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2025), produced by Bundit Buddhahai, Waranyu Wongseree, Pattana Rakkwamsuk. This article describes a dataset for evaluating the effectiveness of energy disaggregation techniques, specifically non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) algorithms. The dataset comprises real-world energy consumption data from a residential household in Bangkok, Thailand. It includes one aggregate circuit and ten active sub-circuits, including lights, plug-outlets, a water pump, a water heater, and an air conditioner, sampled at a 1-minute interval. Coverage: one residence in Thailand. The data are held on Mendeley, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support load disaggregation and household demand studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
